acknowledgedReviews.subject: widgets/title-bar
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Window chrome (drag strip + app name + settings/minimize/close) is app-shell identity: kept standalone so the main shell and any frameless window reuse it without touching the page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: features/download-manager
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Generic download feature (listener + aggregate hooks) kept standalone: currently only the settings window consumes it, but it is a reusable slice the gallery demo and future windows wire independently — not folded into one page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: features/rules
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Per-app rules feature (pure rule-model, running-window picker, add/edit dialog, i18n labels) kept standalone: the main-window Options tab is its only consumer today, but it is a self-contained slice reusable by any window (e.g. a future settings-window rules pane) and independently unit-tested — not folded into the page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: features/display
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Display control feature (value/patch logic, settings persistence, live-preview driver, monitor + engine-state hooks) kept standalone: the main-window Display panel is its only consumer today, but it is a reusable slice the tray and hotkey actions drive independently — not folded into the page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: features/hotkey-actions
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Display hotkey-action catalogue + pure hotkey-patch/validation logic kept standalone: the main-window Options→Hotkeys section is its only frontend consumer today, but the action ids are the shared contract with the Rust registry (armed from settings, fired via hotkey:triggered) and the slice is independently unit-tested — not folded into the page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: features/auto-dark
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Auto Dark feature (autoDark settings persistence through the shared serialized save coordinator) kept standalone: the main-window MagicX → Auto Dark section is its only consumer today, but it is a reusable slice owning the frontend save path for the magicx::theme backend scheduler (Windows app/system theme + taskbar transparency) — paralleling features/display, not folded into the page.

acknowledgedReviews.subject: entities/picker-selection
acknowledgedReviews.reason: Picker-window selection entity (selection model + IPC api) kept standalone: the detachable picker view is its only consumer today, but it is a self-contained entity wired through the picker window's own IPC seam and independently reusable — not folded into the page.
